虚体通道Incorporeal Passage。灵魄可以移动穿过其他生物或物件，如同穿过困难地形一般。如果灵魄结束其回合时还处于有生物或物件的空间内，其将被移入最近的未占据空间中并受到每被移5尺1d10力场伤害。
幽影隐匿Shadow Stealth。若灵魄身处微光光照或黑暗中，其可以使用附赠动作执行躲藏动作。

动作 Actions
多重攻击Multiattack。灵魄发动等同于法术环数一半的次数的攻击（向下取整）。
颤栗之触Chill Touch（仅渗透者）。近战攻击检定：加值等于你的法术攻击加值，触及5尺。命中：1d8+3+法术环阶的寒冷伤害。
蚀命之箭Deathly Bolt（仅暗杀者）。远程攻击检定：加值等于你的法术攻击加值，射程150尺。命中：2d4+3+法术环阶的寒冷伤害。如果该灵魄在发动攻击时处于躲藏，则该攻击额外造成2d4寒冷伤害。
context: column:M;spell:Summon Shadow;book:火炬光下的克苏鲁;level:5
target:
You call forth a shadow spirit. It uses the Shadow Spirit statblock below and appears as a pitch-black silhouette in an unoccupied space you can see within range. When you cast the spell, choose Infiltrator or Assassin; some of its statistics depend on that choice. It disappears when its Hit Points drop to 0 or the spell ends.
The creature is an ally of you and your companions. In combat, it uses your Initiative and acts immediately after your turn. It obeys your verbal commands, requiring no action. If you give no commands, it takes the Dodge action and uses its movement to avoid danger.
Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot: The creature's statistics use the new spell level.
Shadow Spirit
Medium Undead, Neutral
AC: 11 + spell level
HP: 50 (Assassin only) or 40 (Infiltrator only), +10 for each spell level above fifth
Speed: 30 feet, Fly 40 feet (Infiltrator only)
Modifier Save    Modifier Save    Modifier Save
STR 10 +0 +0  DEX 20 +5 +5  CON 15 +2 +2
INT 10 +0 +0  WIS 10 +0 +0  CHA 12 +1 +1
Resistance: Necrotic
Immunity: Cold
Senses: Darkvision 60 feet; Passive Perception 10
CR: None (XP 0; PB = your Proficiency Bonus)

Traits
Incorporeal Passage. The spirit can move through other creatures and objects as if they were Difficult Terrain. If it ends its turn in a space occupied by a creature or object, it is moved into the nearest unoccupied space and takes 1d10 Force damage for every 5 feet it is moved.
Shadow Stealth. While in Dim Light or Darkness, the spirit can take the Hide action as a Bonus Action.

Actions
Multiattack. The spirit makes a number of attacks equal to half the spell level, rounded down.
Chill Touch (Infiltrator only). Melee Attack Roll: bonus equals your spell attack bonus, reach 5 feet. Hit: 1d8+3 + spell level Cold damage.
Deathly Bolt (Assassin only). Ranged Attack Roll: bonus equals your spell attack bonus, range 150 feet. Hit: 2d4+3 + spell level Cold damage. If the spirit is hidden when it makes the attack, the attack deals an extra 2d4 Cold damage.
note: M632 full Cthulhu-source Shadow Spirit retained, including both HP/form options, six score/modifier/save triples, Incorporeal Passage forced relocation damage, Bonus Action Hide and form-specific attacks. The source provides no Language line or different death-damage type, so neither was invented.

source:
直到法术结束前，施法距离内以你所选的一点为中心，降下半径 40 尺、高 40 尺的酸雨。该区域将造成轻度遮蔽，且该区域内的一切开放的明火都将被浇熄。
施法区域内的地面将变为化学物质组成的水坑，使之成为困难地形。当一个生物第一次进入法术区域或在法术区域内开始其回合时，其将受到3d6点强酸伤害，并必须进行一次敏捷豁免。若豁免失败，则该生物将会在水坑中倒地，并额外承受3d6强酸伤害。
升环施法效应：使用六环或更高法术位施展该法术时，你使用的法术位每比五环高一环，法术造成的强酸伤害就额外增加1d6。
target:
Until the spell ends, acid rain falls in an area with a radius of 40 feet and a height of 40 feet centered on a point you choose within range. The area is Lightly Obscured, and all exposed flames inside it are extinguished.
The ground in the area becomes pools of chemicals and is Difficult Terrain. When a creature first enters the spell's area or starts its turn there, it takes 3d6 Acid damage and must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, it falls Prone in the pools and takes an additional 3d6 Acid damage.
Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of sixth level or higher, the spell's Acid damage increases by 1d6 for each slot level above fifth.
note: M633 Acid Rain: automatic initial 3d6 is separate from failed-save Prone/additional 3d6. The source says first entry without a per-turn qualifier; none added. Area, obscurity, flames and Difficult Terrain preserved.

source:
你在施法距离内由你所选的一点创造一个半径10尺的毒雾球体。这团毒雾会扩散过角落。毒雾会持续存在到法术结束，或直到有一股强风将其吹散以结束此法术。毒雾所在的区域视为重度遮蔽。
当一个生物在其回合内第一次进入毒雾或在毒雾中开始回合时，其必须进行一次智力豁免。若豁免失败则需承受3d6点心灵伤害，并陷入震慑状态直到其下一个回合开始。若豁免检定成功则该生物受到一半伤害且不会被震慑。即使屏住呼吸，或不需要呼吸的生物也会受到此法术的影响。
升环施法效应：使用六环或更高法术位施展该法术时，你使用的法术位每比五环高一环，法术造成的心灵伤害就额外增加1d6。
target:
You create a sphere of poisonous gas with a radius of 10 feet at a point you choose within range. The gas spreads around corners and lasts until the spell ends or a strong wind disperses it, ending the spell. Its area is Heavily Obscured.
When a creature enters the gas for the first time on its turn or starts its turn there, it must make an Intelligence saving throw. On a failure, it takes 3d6 Psychic damage and has the Stunned condition until the start of its next turn. On a success, it takes half as much damage and is not Stunned. Holding one's breath or not needing to breathe does not prevent this spell from affecting a creature.
Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of sixth level or higher, the spell's Psychic damage increases by 1d6 for each slot level above fifth.
note: M634 Nerve Gas: Intelligence save and Psychic damage are retained despite the gas description. Preserved on-its-turn entry timing, next-turn Stunned ending, breathing exception and wind dismissal.

source: 选择范围内你能看到的一个生命值未全满的生物，你用糜烂的细菌将它的伤口感染。该目标必须通过一次体质豁免，如果其生命值已经少于最大生命值的一半，它进行的本次豁免将承受劣势。若豁免失败，则目标需承受10d8点黯蚀伤害，并获得一层力竭。若豁免检定成功，则它只承受一半伤害且不积累任何力竭层数。
target: Choose a creature you can see within range whose Hit Points are not full. You infect its wounds with putrefying bacteria. It must make a Constitution saving throw, with disadvantage on this save if its Hit Points are already less than half its Hit Point maximum. On a failure, it takes 10d8 Necrotic damage and gains one Exhaustion level. On a success, it takes half as much damage and gains no Exhaustion levels.
note: M635 Septic Shock: non-full-HP targeting, strictly less than half for disadvantage, 10d8 and failure-only one Exhaustion level preserved.

source:
你创造出四道纯毒素组成的射线并掷向范围内你能看见的生物。你可以射击同一个或多个目标。
每道射线需要你分别进行一次远程法术攻击。若命中，则目标受到 3d6 点毒素伤害。如果一个生物被一个或多个射线命中，它必须通过一次体质豁免。若豁免检定失败，则该生物陷入中毒状态一分钟。若以此法中毒，该生物可以在它的每个回合结束重新进行一次体质豁免，若豁免成功，则中毒状态终止。
升环施法效应：使用六环或更高法术位施展该法术时，你使用的法术位每比五环高一环，你就额外创造一条射线。
target:
You create four rays of pure poison and hurl them at creatures you can see within range. You can aim them at the same target or at different targets.
Make a separate ranged spell attack for each ray. On a hit, the target takes 3d6 Poison damage. A creature hit by one or more rays must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failure, it has the Poisoned condition for one minute. A creature Poisoned in this way can repeat the Constitution save at the end of each of its turns, ending the condition on a success.
Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of sixth level or higher, you create one additional ray for each slot level above fifth.
note: M636 Toxic Barrage: four initial rays, separate attack rolls, one save after one-or-more hits, one-minute Poisoned/end-turn recovery and one-ray scaling retained.

source:
风，环绕着你的躯体，卷起你的头发和衣摆，并将你的双脚托到空中。你获得60尺飞行速度。此外，你为避免被 擒抱Grappled 所作的属性检定，以及避免陷入 束缚Restrained 或 麻痹Paralyzed 所作的豁免检定具有优势。
法术效应期间，若你被选为一道法术或一次攻击的目标，你可以用你的反应传送到至多60尺外的一处未被占据的空间内。如果此行动使你脱离了该法术或该攻击的范围，你便不会受其影响。传送结束后，本法术会立刻结束。
context: column:M;spell:Freedom of the Wind;book:塔尔多雷战役设定集：重制版;level:5
target:
Wind surrounds your body, stirring your hair and clothes and lifting your feet into the air. You gain a Fly Speed of 60 feet. You also have advantage on ability checks to avoid being Grappled, and on saving throws to avoid the Restrained or Paralyzed conditions.
While the spell is in effect, when you are targeted by a spell or an attack, you can use your Reaction to teleport to an unoccupied space up to 60 feet away. If this takes you outside that spell's or attack's range, it does not affect you. This spell ends immediately after the teleport.
note: M637 Freedom of the Wind: kept checks against Grappled distinct from saves against Restrained/Paralyzed. Reactive teleport has no added visibility restriction; protection is conditional on leaving range and ends the spell.

source:
施法时，你在空白车票上书写一个你已熟知站号的永久列车站代码。当游荡之线沿着突然显现的轨道抵达时，你身后会出现一个微光闪烁的站牌和一张小长凳。你的车票允许你和至多八个你选择的生物乘车。无论距离多远，抵达目的地都需要1小时。
在旅程中可能会出现其他停靠站，这由DM决定。如果你或任何友方生物选择在旅行期间进行短休，且在短休结束时通过消耗一个或多个生命骰恢复生命值，你还会额外恢复1d10点生命值。
世界中存在着无数的列车站，每个都有其独特的列车站号。当你首次获得施展此法术的能力时，你会学会两个由DM决定的目的地代码。你可以在冒险过程中学习更多代码。研究新的代码序列1分钟后，你就能将其记忆。
context: column:M;spell:Create Spirit Train Stop;book:胧忆岛：蒿野物语;level:5
target:
When you cast the spell, you write on a blank ticket the code of a permanent train station whose station number you know. As the Wandering Line arrives along tracks that suddenly appear, a shimmering station sign and a small bench appear behind you. Your ticket allows you and up to eight creatures you choose to ride. Reaching the destination takes 1 hour, regardless of distance.
Other stops might appear during the journey, as the DM decides. If you or any friendly creature takes a Short Rest during the trip and regains Hit Points by spending one or more Hit Dice at its end, you also regain an extra 1d10 Hit Points.
Countless train stations exist in the world, each with its own station number. When you first gain the ability to cast this spell, you learn two destination codes chosen by the DM. You can learn more during your adventures. Studying a new code sequence for 1 minute lets you memorize it.
note: M638 Create Spirit Train Stop: ticket/codes, eight passengers plus caster, travel/rest and learned-code rules retained. Wandering Line is a literal descriptive rendering, not a verified official name. Source awards extra healing to you after you OR a friendly creature rests; that pronoun is preserved rather than reassigned.

source:
选择施法距离内的一个生物。伴随着铜管乐器的演奏声，一顶华丽的王冠和斗篷出现在目标身上。在持续时间内，目标成为庆典之王，并散发出一种重要人物的气场。任何生物在其回合内首次移动到庆典之王周围20尺范围内，或在该范围内开始其回合时，必须进行一次魅力豁免。不会被魅惑的生物自动通过此豁免。豁免失败的生物将被庆典之王吸引，围绕其欢呼起舞。在法术效应影响下的生物会在其回合开始时将其动作和附赠动作都用来向庆典之王献上全部的关注与崇拜。
如果生物在其回合开始时处于庆典之王光环范围外，则不再受到该法术的影响。
target:
Choose a creature within range. With the sound of brass instruments, an ornate crown and cloak appear on the target. For the duration, it becomes the Festival King and radiates an air of importance. When a creature first moves within 20 feet of the Festival King on its turn or starts its turn within that distance, it must make a Charisma saving throw. A creature that cannot be Charmed automatically succeeds. On a failure, it is captivated by the Festival King and cheers and dances around it. At the start of its turn, a creature affected by the spell devotes both its action and Bonus Action to giving the Festival King its full attention and adoration.
If a creature is outside the Festival King's aura at the start of its turn, it is no longer affected by the spell.
note: M639 Festival King: automatic success for charm-immune creatures, own-turn first-entry/start trigger, both actions at turn start and leaving-aura-at-turn-start ending retained. The text's captivated behavior is not silently converted into an additional named Charmed condition.

source:
你选择施法距离内最多六个你能看见的生物或物体，使其垂直升起最多20尺，并在法术持续时间内悬浮于空中。此法术可以使重量不超过500磅的目标浮空。非自愿的生物若通过体质豁免则不受影响。
目标只能通过推拉触及范围内的固定物体或表面（比如墙壁或天花板）来移动，如同在攀爬一般。在你的回合中，你可以在20尺之内改变任意数量目标的高度。如果你是其中一个目标，作为移动的一部分，你可以将目标上下移动。否则，你可以使用你的动作移动这些目标，但目标必须始终保持在施法距离内。
当法术结束时，仍在空中的目标会缓慢飘落至地面。
target:
Choose up to six creatures or objects you can see within range. They rise vertically up to 20 feet and remain suspended for the duration. The spell can levitate a target weighing no more than 500 pounds. An unwilling creature is unaffected if it succeeds on a Constitution saving throw.
A target can move only by pushing or pulling against a fixed object or surface within reach, such as a wall or ceiling, as if climbing. On your turn, you can change the height of any number of targets by up to 20 feet. If you are one of the targets, you can move targets up or down as part of your movement. Otherwise, you can use your action to move them, but they must remain within the spell's range.
When the spell ends, any targets still aloft float gently to the ground.
note: M640 Mass Levitate: all target/weight/save, surface movement, height change and ending rules retained. In the caster-is-a-target branch the source says move the target(s), not only yourself; the translation does not narrow that ambiguous permission.

source:
八只纸鹤从施法时消耗的纸张中飞出，朝着施法距离内你能看见的一个生物飞去。如果目标在你施法时位于30尺以内，纸鹤群会与目标相撞，对其造成8d6点挥砍伤害，然后纸鹤消失。
如果目标在你施法时距离你超过30尺，纸鹤群会以每轮30尺的速度朝目标方向飞行，无视困难地形，并可以根据需要绕过生物和其他障碍物。在飞行过程中，纸鹤群会如同一个中型生物一样占据一个5尺边长的立方体空间。
在飞行过程中，纸鹤群可以被攻击。其AC等同于你的法术豁免DC。每当纸鹤群被一次攻击命中，群体中的纸鹤数量就会减少一只。
在纸鹤群到达目标的那一轮，在你回合开始时，目标会因群体中每只剩余的纸鹤受到1d6点挥砍伤害。然后纸鹤消失。
升环施法。使用六环或更高法术位施展该法术时，你使用的法术位每比五环高一环，纸鹤群的数量就增加两只；如果目标在你施法时位于30尺以内，你使用的法术位每比五环高一环，它就额外受到2d6点挥砍伤害。
context: column:M;spell:Origami Bird Swarm;book:胧忆岛：蒿野物语;level:5
target:
Eight paper cranes fly from the paper consumed when you cast the spell toward a creature you can see within range. If the target is within 30 feet of you when you cast, the swarm collides with it, deals 8d6 Slashing damage, and disappears.
If the target is farther than 30 feet away when you cast, the swarm flies toward it at 30 feet per round, ignoring Difficult Terrain and going around creatures and other obstacles as needed. In flight, it occupies a cube 5 feet on a side, like a Medium creature.
The swarm can be attacked while in flight. Its AC equals your spell save DC. Each attack that hits it reduces the number of cranes by one.
At the start of your turn in the round when the swarm reaches its target, the target takes 1d6 Slashing damage for each remaining crane. The cranes then disappear.
Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of sixth level or higher, the swarm has two additional cranes for each slot level above fifth. If the target is within 30 feet of you when you cast, it takes an additional 2d6 Slashing damage for each slot level above fifth.
note: M641 Origami Bird Swarm: distinct immediate-hit and flying-swarm branches retained, including per-round movement, space/AC, one-crane loss per hit, arrival-round turn-start damage and both scaling clauses. No saving throw or missing movement ruling invented.

source:
此法术在施法距离内的一处水体与同一存在位面上500英里内的另一处水体之间创造出一道魔法链接。你必须曾经至少见过或接触过目标水体一次。在法术持续时间内，任何生物都可以使用5尺移动力踏入源水体，并从目标水体中现身。
源水体和目标水体都必须足够大，能让试图通过的生物完全没入水中。如果任一水体不足以让生物完全没入，则有25%的几率使该生物从同一存在位面上的随机水体中现身。
target:
This spell creates a magical link between a body of water within range and another body of water on the same plane of existence within 500 miles. You must have seen or touched the destination body of water at least once. For the duration, any creature can spend 5 feet of movement to enter the source water and emerge from the destination water.
Both bodies of water must be large enough to completely submerge a creature attempting to pass through. If either is not large enough, there is a 25% chance that the creature emerges from a random body of water on the same plane.
note: M642 Submerge: explicit miles, seen-or-touched destination, movement cost and same-plane limits preserved. The source states a size requirement and then a 25% exception when it is unmet; both retained without resolving their tension.

source:
在施法距离内你可见的一点，一个巨型南瓜灯迅速生长而出。它可以容纳该点为中心、半径5尺范围内的生物。你可以选择让它容纳范围内最多四个中型或更小的生物，或者一个大型生物。任何不愿被困入南瓜灯中的生物可以进行一次敏捷豁免检定，若检定成功，该生物可以迅速跳离5尺距离，避开南瓜灯的包裹。
在南瓜灯内的生物只能通过你施法时选定的一侧上的眼睛和嘴巴观察外界。生物只能从这一侧使用远程或触及武器进行攻击。南瓜灯外的生物透过其嘴巴或眼睛往里看时，只能看到温暖的发光。在南瓜灯存在期间，无论南瓜灯内外的生物都无法穿过它。
南瓜灯重5,000磅，AC为15，具有100点生命值。南瓜灯每年自然损失20点生命值。当南瓜灯生命值降至0时，它会被摧毁。
target:
A Huge jack-o'-lantern rapidly grows at a point you can see within range. It can enclose creatures within a radius of 5 feet centered on that point. You can choose to enclose up to four Medium or smaller creatures in the area, or one Large creature. A creature unwilling to be trapped can make a Dexterity saving throw. On a success, it can jump 5 feet away to avoid being enclosed.
Creatures inside can see out only through the eyes and mouth on a side you choose when you cast the spell. They can attack with ranged or reach weapons only through that side. Creatures outside looking through the mouth or eyes see only a warm glow. While the jack-o'-lantern exists, creatures on either side cannot pass through it.
The jack-o'-lantern weighs 5,000 pounds, has AC 15, and has 100 Hit Points. It naturally loses 20 Hit Points each year. It is destroyed when its Hit Points drop to 0.
note: M643 Summon Jack-O'-Lantern: full enclosure/save, one-sided visibility/attacks, passage prohibition and object durability retained, including annual 20-HP loss; no creature statblock or escape action added.

source:
你以抛洒香料和旋转起舞的华丽仪式将一顿饭菜圣化。享用这顿饭菜的人将获得伟大节日之灵谭冈的咖喱祝福。这顿盛宴需要1小时食用，其效果要等到食用完毕后才会生效。最多十二个生物可以参与这场盛宴。
参与盛宴的生物获得以下好处：该生物的力竭等级降低一级，速度增加10尺，并在敏捷豁免检定上获得+2加值。在盛宴效果持续期间，他还可以使用一次"余烬腹火Ember Belly"法术的效果。盛宴的效果持续24小时。
context: column:M;spell:Tamh Gon's Fiery Festival Feast;book:胧忆岛：蒿野物语;level:5
target:
With an elaborate ritual of scattering spices and whirling in dance, you consecrate a meal. Those who eat it receive the curry blessing of Tamh Gon, the great spirit of festivals. The feast takes 1 hour to consume, and its effects begin only after it is finished. Up to twelve creatures can partake.
A participant gains these benefits: its Exhaustion level decreases by one, its speed increases by 10 feet, and it gains a +2 bonus to Dexterity saving throws. During the feast's effects, it can also use the effect of Ember Belly once. The feast's effects last 24 hours.
note: M644 Tamh Gon's Fiery Festival Feast: full ritual, one-hour completion gate, twelve participants and all four benefits/duration retained. Ember Belly remains a one-time use of its effect, without invented casting details.

source:
你以施法距离内一点为源点，创造出一个30尺立方的阴影区域，收割流失的生命力。当区域出现时位于其中的与你敌对的生物，或在一个回合内首次进入该区域或在该区域内结束自己回合的生物，都会被诅咒，直至其下一回合结束。在被诅咒期间，当该生物在一个回合内首次受到伤害时，其会额外受到1d6暗蚀伤害，并且区域内一个你选择的未被此诅咒影响的生物，恢复等于所造成暗蚀伤害的生命值。 
升环施法。使用的法术位每比五环高一环，伤害就增加1d6。
target:
You create a 30-foot cube of shadow originating at a point within range, harvesting escaping life force. A creature hostile to you that is in the area when it appears, or a creature that enters the area for the first time on a turn or ends its turn there, is cursed until the end of its next turn. While cursed, the first time it takes damage on a turn, it takes an extra 1d6 Necrotic damage, and one creature you choose in the area that is not affected by this curse regains Hit Points equal to the Necrotic damage dealt.
Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot: The damage increases by 1d6 for each slot level above fifth.
note: M645 Field of Reaping: preserved the source's branch wording: hostile creatures on appearance, then entry/end-turn creatures without a repeated hostility qualifier. Curse expiry, once-per-turn damage and un-cursed in-area healing target retained; no hostility narrowing added.

source:
你选择施法距离内的一种生物令其被吞噬同类血肉的欲望所覆盖。目标必须通过一次魅力豁免，否则它的牙齿会变成针状，并且它能通过气味锁定150尺内的同类生物。轮到它的回合时，该生物必须以最快的速度向最近的同类生物移动。如果它在5尺内有着同类型的生物，它必须使用附赠动作对其进行啃咬攻击。目标熟练啃咬攻击，并造成伤害1d6+力量调整值的伤害。如果周围150尺内没有同类型的生物，它必须攻击距离它最近的生物。
在其每个回合结束时，以及每次受到伤害时，目标都可以重新豁免。如果豁免是由伤害触发的，则目标在豁免时具有优势。如果成功，法术结束，目标会中毒1小时。除非它是食人魔或来自食人文化。
target:
You choose a creature within range and overwhelm it with a desire to devour the flesh of its own kind. The target must succeed on a Charisma saving throw or its teeth become needle-like and it can locate creatures of its own kind within 150 feet by scent. On its turn, it must move as quickly as possible toward the nearest creature of its own kind. If a creature of the same type is within 5 feet, it must use a Bonus Action to bite it. The target is proficient with the bite attack, which deals 1d6 + its Strength modifier damage. If there is no creature of the same type within 150 feet, it must attack the nearest creature.
At the end of each of its turns and whenever it takes damage, the target can repeat the save. It has advantage if damage triggered the save. On a success, the spell ends and the target has the Poisoned condition for 1 hour, unless it is an Ogre or comes from a cannibalistic culture.
note: M649 Feast of Flesh: source opens with a kind-of-creature phrase but subsequently treats a single target; no extra target count inferred. Kept same-kind pursuit, fallback nearest attack, Bonus Action bite, unspecified bite damage type, damage-triggered save advantage and post-spell Poisoned exception.

source:
你创造了一个能干大事的生物，就像一名故事书中的勇士，同时让该生物的敌人值得英雄关注。你选择施法距离内一生物，在法术持续时间内，其在所有属性检定、攻击和豁免上具有优势。同时，攻击你目标的生物，或对源自你目标的法术或其他效应进行豁免的生物具有优势。非自愿目标需进行一次魅力豁免抵抗该效果。
升环施法。当你用七环或更高环阶的法术位施展该法术时，每比六环高一环，便可额外增加一个生物为目标。
target:
You make a creature capable of great deeds like a hero from a storybook, while making its enemies worthy of a hero's attention. Choose a creature within range. For the duration, it has advantage on all ability checks, attacks, and saving throws. Creatures attacking the target, or making saving throws against its spells or other effects, also have advantage. An unwilling target makes a Charisma saving throw to resist the effect.
Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of seventh level or higher, you can target one additional creature for each slot level above sixth.
note: M650 Hero of Fable: retained advantages for both target and its opponents plus unwilling-target save. Although B is level5, source upcasting starts at seventh and scales above sixth; this discrepancy is preserved.

source:
你选择施法距离内一可见目标消耗其血肉。你的目标在法术持续期间必须在其每个回合开始时通过一次体质豁免，否则受到3d8点暗蚀伤害。在此法术作用下，生命值降为0的目标在死亡豁免上具有劣势。如果你的目标死亡，你可以在你的回合以附赠动作将其复活为丧尸Zombie，并且只要你在它60尺内，你就可以在随后的每个回合使用一个附赠动作来精神指挥它。如果你因多次施放此法术或类似法术（如活化死尸Animate Dead ）而命令多个亡灵，你可以使用相同的附赠动作同时命令其中任何一个或所有亡灵生物，对每个亡灵生物发出相同的命令。你决定该生物在下一回合将采取什么动作以及它将移动到哪里，或者你可以发出一般命令，例如守卫一个特定的房间或走廊。如果你不发出命令，该生物只会自卫敌对生物。一旦接到命令，这种生物就会继续执行，直到任务完成。
该生物在你的控制下24小时，之后它将不再服从你给它的任何命令。若要继续控制该生物24小时，你必须在当前的24小时时段结束前使用一个五环或更高的法术位。
升环施法。当你用七环或更高环阶的法术位施展该法术时，你的目标在其每个回合开始时受到6d8点暗蚀伤害，如果它死亡，则以食尸鬼Ghoul的形式复活。当你用9环法术位施展该法术时，你的目标在其每个回合开始时受到9d8点暗蚀伤害，如果它死亡，则以妖鬼Ghast的形式复活。
target:
Choose a target you can see within range and consume its flesh. For the duration, it must succeed on a Constitution saving throw at the start of each of its turns or take 3d8 Necrotic damage. A target reduced to 0 Hit Points while under this spell has disadvantage on Death Saving Throws. If your target dies, you can use a Bonus Action on your turn to reanimate it as a Zombie. As long as you are within 60 feet of it, you can use a Bonus Action on each subsequent turn to command it mentally. If you command multiple Undead through repeated castings of this spell or similar spells such as Animate Dead, you can use the same Bonus Action to command any or all of them, issuing the same command to each. You decide what actions it takes and where it moves on its next turn, or give a general order, such as guarding a room or corridor. Without a command, it only defends itself against hostile creatures. Once commanded, it continues until the task is complete.
The creature remains under your control for 24 hours, after which it no longer obeys your commands. To keep control for another 24 hours, you must expend a spell slot of fifth level or higher before the current 24-hour period ends.
Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of seventh level or higher, the target takes 6d8 Necrotic damage at the start of each of its turns and, if it dies, is reanimated as a Ghoul. When you cast it using a level 9 spell slot, the target takes 9d8 Necrotic damage at the start of each of its turns and, if it dies, is reanimated as a Ghast.
note: M651 Krail's Rot: preserved failed-save base damage, death-save penalty, optional reanimation, all command/control/upkeep rules and seventh/ninth upgrades. Source gives no action for maintenance-slot expenditure and no added damage-caused-death requirement; neither invented. Higher-slot paragraphs retain their stated damage wording.

source:
你讲述的故事蜿蜒曲折，充满了旁白和离题，以至于听众都不知道故事的重点在哪里。任何陷入耳聋或无法被魅惑的生物都免疫此法术的效果。
你选择距离你20尺内任意名生物，他们被迫停下手中的工作，聆听你的故事。当他们被你的话所吸引时、它们会在智力（调查）和感知（洞悉和察觉）检定中自动失败，且他们在这些技能上的被动检定结果会变为0。生物可以选择离开你的表演，但必须先通过一次感知豁免，否则会陷入昏迷1分钟。如果你失能或不再说话，此法术就会终止。
target:
Your story winds through so many asides and digressions that listeners lose track of its point. Creatures that have the Deafened condition or cannot be Charmed are immune to this spell's effects.
Choose any number of creatures within 20 feet of you. They are compelled to stop what they are doing and listen. While captivated by your words, they automatically fail Intelligence (Investigation) and Wisdom (Insight and Perception) checks, and their passive check results for those skills become 0. A creature can choose to leave your performance, but must first succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or have the Unconscious condition for 1 minute. The spell ends if you are Incapacitated or stop speaking.
note: M652 Leiloch's Interminable Yarn: deaf/charm-immune exclusions, all three skills and passive0, exit-save failure Unconscious, and caster-incapacitated/silenced-by-stopping ending preserved.

source:
如同法术迷失Lost（见上文）一样，除了目标会忘记所有导航技能和地标外，目标会被迫四处游荡（仅在自卫时攻击）。16小时后，目标可以 进行另一次感知豁免。 如果失败，生物就会陷入开始一场精疲力竭的长休。
移除诅咒Remove Curse或高等复原术Greater Restoration会终止此效果。
升环施法。当你使用六环或更高的法术位施放此法术时，每比五环高一环便可额外指定一名生物为目标。这些生物必须相距在30尺内。如果你使用了七环或更高的法术位施展该法术，目标会在第二天经历该法术、醒来后进行一次感知豁免继续游荡。 如果你使用九环或更高的法术位，目标会在一周内的每天经历此法术，持续一周。
target:
This works like Lost (see above), except that, in addition to forgetting all navigation skills and landmarks, the target is compelled to wander, attacking only in self-defense. After 16 hours, it can make another Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, it begins an exhausting Long Rest.
Remove Curse or Greater Restoration ends this effect.
Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of sixth level or higher, you can target one additional creature for each slot level above fifth. These creatures must be within 30 feet of one another. If you use a slot of seventh level or higher, the target experiences the spell again on the second day, making a Wisdom saving throw on waking before continuing to wander. If you use a slot of ninth level or higher, the target experiences the spell each day for a week.
note: M653 Lost and Wandering: retained the source Lost cross-reference and all duration/target/range conditions. The source does not state the successful 16-hour-save outcome and has an unclear second-day save/continued-wandering clause. The second-day phrase uses before continuing only to express sequence, without inventing a success/failure branch. No mechanical Exhaustion level is added to the exhausting Long Rest.

source:
一道光柱从空中落下，填满你所在的方格周围5尺内的区域。区域内的其他生物都必须进行一次体质豁免，豁免失败的生物会受到4d8点光耀伤害并目盲到你的下一回合开始。豁免成功者所受伤害减半且不会目盲。亡灵和泥怪在此豁免中具有劣势。
法术持续时间内，一道绚丽的光柱会在你周围闪耀，并随你移动。它提供半径10尺的明亮光照和该范围外20尺的微光光照。该光照是阳光。
该法术的光线在夜间可从10里外的地方看到，在黄昏时可从5里外的地方看到。
target:
A pillar of light descends from the sky and fills the area within 5 feet of your square. Other creatures in the area must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 4d8 Radiant damage and has the Blinded condition until the start of your next turn. On a success, it takes half as much damage and is not Blinded. Undead and Oozes have disadvantage on this save.
For the duration, a brilliant pillar of light shines around you and moves with you. It sheds Bright Light in a radius of 10 feet and Dim Light for an additional 20 feet. This light is sunlight.
The spell's light can be seen from 10 li away at night and 5 li away at dusk.
note: M654 Radiant Beacon: retained initial other-creature save, Undead/Ooze disadvantage, moving sunlight and both visibility distances. Bare li is unconverted; no recurring damage trigger added to the moving light.

source:
月光从天而降，在持续时间内以微光光照笼罩源自你的20尺光环区域。你和你的盟友在位于该区域期间获得半身掩护及对寒冷、闪电及光耀伤害的抗性。
在法术持续时间内，你可以使用以下选项之一（但这将令此法术立即结束）：
解放Liberation。当你失败于一次用于避免或结束恐慌、受擒及束缚的豁免时，你可以用一个反应来将本次豁免改为成功。
回春Respite。以一个魔法动作，你或区域内的一名盟友恢复等于4d10+你的施法属性调整值点生命值。
context: column:M;spell:Alustriel's Mooncloak;book:被遗忘的国度：费伦英雄;level:5
target:
Moonlight falls from above, filling a 20-foot Emanation originating from you with Dim Light for the duration. While in the area, you and your allies have Half Cover and resistance to Cold, Lightning, and Radiant damage.
During the spell's duration, you can use one of the following options, which immediately ends this spell:
Liberation. When you fail a saving throw to avoid or end the Frightened, Grappled, or Restrained condition, you can use a Reaction to turn that save into a success.
Respite. As a Magic action, you or one ally in the area regains Hit Points equal to 4d10 + your spellcasting ability modifier.
note: M655 Alustriel's Mooncloak: preserved aura benefits and either-option immediate spell ending. Liberation remains a failed saving throw, even for Grappled/Restrained, and is not broadened to ability checks.

source:
你将属于巨灵的元素之力注入自身。你获得以下增益，直至法术结束：
元素减免Elemental Immunity。当你施展该法术时，选择下列一种伤害类型：强酸、寒冷、火焰、闪电或雷鸣。你获得对所选伤害类型的抗性。
元素波动Elemental Pulse。在你施展该法术时，以及此后你的每个回合开始时，你都会释放出元素能量的爆发，覆盖源自自身的15尺光环区域。区域内每名由你选择的生物都要进行一次敏捷豁免，豁免失败者受到2d6点强酸、寒冷、火焰、闪电或雷鸣伤害（由你选择）并陷入倒地状态，豁免成功则仅受半伤。
翔天Flight。你获得30尺飞行速度且可悬浮。
结阵施法。若该法术被作为结阵法术施展，则其施法时间变为1分钟，且持续时间增加至专注，至多10分钟。每有一名辅施法者参与，你就可以额外选择一名生物（至多额外选择九名生物）。受选择的生物亦会在法术持续时间内获得其增益。
施展该法术时，每一名辅施法者都必须消耗一枚二环及以上的法术位，否则法术失败。
context: column:M;spell:Songal's Elemental Suffusion;book:被遗忘的国度：费伦英雄;level:5
target:
You imbue yourself with the elemental power of genies. Until the spell ends, you gain these benefits:
Elemental Immunity. When you cast the spell, choose Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Thunder damage. You gain resistance to the chosen damage type.
Elemental Pulse. When you cast the spell and at the start of each of your turns thereafter, you release a burst of elemental energy in a 15-foot Emanation originating from you. Each creature you choose in the area must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, it takes 2d6 Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Thunder damage, as you choose, and has the Prone condition. On a success, it takes only half damage.
Flight. You gain a Fly Speed of 30 feet and can hover.
Circle Casting. If cast as a circle spell, its casting time becomes 1 minute and its duration increases to Concentration, up to 10 minutes. For each secondary caster participating, you can choose one additional creature, up to nine additional creatures. Chosen creatures also gain its benefits for the duration.
When the spell is cast, each secondary caster must expend a spell slot of second level or higher, or the spell fails.
note: M656 Songal's Elemental Suffusion: supplied English heading Elemental Immunity is retained, but its actual benefit remains resistance. All five damage choices, pulse failure/Prone, hover and circle casting participants/cost/time/duration are complete; pulse damage is not forced to match the resistance choice.

source:
你创造两个相连的传送门。指定地面上你能看见的两处未被占据的大型空间，其中一点在法术距离内，另一点则在你身边 10 尺内。随后将会开启一个通往两处的圆形传送门，并持续到法术结束。
传送门边缘为闪烁的二维环形，其内布满遮挡视野的迷雾，且整个垂直地悬浮在离地几寸处。传送门单面开启（由你选择），那一面即是传送门生效的一面。
任何进入其中一个传送门的东西将从另一个传送门里出现，如同两个传送门邻接一样。以一个附赠动作，你可以改变其开门的朝向。
target:
You create two linked portals. Choose two unoccupied Large spaces on the ground that you can see, one within the spell's range and the other within 10 feet of you. Circular portals linking the two locations then open and remain until the spell ends.
Their edges are shimmering two-dimensional rings filled with mist that blocks vision. Each floats vertically a few cun above the ground. A portal opens on only one side, which you choose; that is its active side.
Anything entering one portal emerges from the other as though they were adjacent. As a Bonus Action, you can change the direction in which they open.
note: M657 Arcane Gate: both visible unoccupied Large ground spaces, near/far placement, obscuring mist, one-sided operation and Bonus Action orientation retained. Bare cun stays unconverted; no extra portal dimension added.

source:
你创造出一面由旋转着的魔法能量剑刃组成的墙壁。墙壁在持续时间内在你的施法距离之内持续存在。你可以选择创造长不过100尺、高不过20尺、厚不过5尺的直墙；或是直径不过60尺、高不过20尺、厚不过5尺的环形墙。墙提供四分之三掩护，而墙体所占据的空间则视为困难地形。
所有处于墙所占据空间的生物必须进行一次敏捷豁免，豁免失败者受到6d10力场伤害，成功则受到一半伤害。生物在进入墙所占据的空间或者在其中结束回合时也需要进行此豁免。一个生物每回合只会进行一次此豁免。
target:
You create a wall of whirling blades of magical energy. The wall remains within range for the duration. You can make a straight wall up to 100 feet long, 20 feet high, and 5 feet thick, or a ringed wall up to 60 feet in diameter, 20 feet high, and 5 feet thick. It provides Three-Quarters Cover, and its space is Difficult Terrain.
Every creature in the wall's space must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 6d10 Force damage on a failure or half as much on a success. A creature also makes this save when it enters the wall's space or ends its turn there. A creature makes this save only once per turn.
note: M658 2024 Blade Barrier: retained straight/ring dimensions (60-foot diameter, not radius), cover, terrain and once-per-turn save limit. Damage is the source's Force, not remembered Slashing.

source:
你放出一道闪电，射向施法距离内某个你能看见的指定目标。经过首个目标后，闪电分成三束跳向该目标30尺内至多3个其他目标。闪电的目标可以是生物或物件，但每束闪电必须指定不同的目标。
每个目标必须进行一次敏捷豁免。豁免失败者将受到10d8点闪电伤害，豁免成功受到半数伤害。
升环施法：使用高于六环的法术位施展该法术时，你使用的法术位每比六环高一环，跳跃后闪电就多分出一束射向一个不同的目标。
target:
You release a bolt of lightning at a target you can see within range. From the first target, the lightning divides into three bolts that leap to up to 3 other targets within 30 feet of it. Targets can be creatures or objects, but each bolt must have a different target.
Each target must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 10d8 Lightning damage on a failure or half as much on a success.
Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot: When you cast this spell using a slot above sixth level, the leaping lightning produces one additional bolt aimed at a different target for each slot level above sixth.
note: M659 Chain Lightning: original target plus up to3 different secondary creature/object targets, distance from first target, all saves/damage and one additional different target per higher level preserved.

source:
一阵负能量波从施法距离内你选择的一点放出，覆盖以该点为中心半径60尺球状区域。每个位于区域内的生物都进行一次体质豁免。豁免失败者受到8d8点暗蚀伤害，豁免成功则受到半数伤害。
升环施法：使用的法术位每比六环高一环，法术的伤害就增加2d8。
target:
A wave of negative energy spreads from a point you choose within range, filling a Sphere with a radius of 60 feet centered there. Each creature in the area makes a Constitution saving throw, taking 8d8 Necrotic damage on a failure or half as much on a success.
Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot: The damage increases by 2d8 for each slot level above sixth.
note: M660 Circle of Death: 60-foot-radius Sphere, each-creature Constitution save, 8d8 and 2d8 scaling preserved; no unlisted exclusions.

source:
你将来自妖精荒野的中型精魂咒唤在施法距离内一处你可见的未占据空间中。精魂在持续时间内一直存在，其外貌看起来像是一名你选择的妖精生物。当精魂显现时，你可以对位于精魂5尺内的一名生物进行一次近战法术攻击。命中则目标受到等于3d12加你施法属性调整值总和的心灵伤害，并且直到你的下个回合开始为止，目标处于恐慌状态，你和精魂均是目标的恐惧源。
在后续的你的回合中，以一个附赠动作，你可以将精魂传送至一处位于其原位置30尺内的你可见的未占据空间，并对位于精魂5尺内的一名生物进行上述攻击。
升环施法： 使用的法术位每比六环高一环，法术造成的伤害就增加2d12。
target:
You conjure a Medium spirit from the Feywild in an unoccupied space you can see within range. It remains for the duration and looks like a Fey creature you choose. When it appears, you can make a melee spell attack against a creature within 5 feet of it. On a hit, the target takes Psychic damage equal to 3d12 + your spellcasting ability modifier and has the Frightened condition until the start of your next turn. Both you and the spirit are the sources of its fear.
On later turns, you can use a Bonus Action to teleport the spirit to an unoccupied space you can see within 30 feet of its previous location and make the same attack against a creature within 5 feet of it.
Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot: The spell's damage increases by 2d12 for each slot level above sixth.
note: M661 Conjure Fey: preserved appearance/later Bonus Action attacks, teleport from spirit's prior location, both fear sources and next-turn expiry. No creature statblock or separate summoned ally mechanics substituted.

source:
选择一道五环或以下的你能够施展的法术，其施法时间需为动作且能够以你为目标。这道法术被称为凭依法术。你作为施展触发术的一部分施展凭依法术，同时消耗凭依法术与触发术的法术位，但凭依法术并不会立即生效，而是在满足特定触发条件时才生效。你在施展这两道法术的时候描述触发条件。例如，触发术与水下呼吸Water Breathing 一起施展可以确保水下呼吸在你被水或类似液体淹没时触发其效应。
凭依法术的效应在相应状况第一次出现时立即生效，而无论你是否想要这么做，在那之后触发术随即终止。
凭依法术的效应只能作用于你，哪怕它通常可以指定其他目标也无法再作指定。你同一时间只能使用一道触发术。如果你再次施展该法术，则你身上前一道触发术的效应立即终止。另外，当触发术的材料成分不在你身上时，你身上的触发术效应也将立即终止。
target:
Choose a spell of fifth level or lower that you can cast, that has a casting time of an action, and that can target you. This is the contingent spell. You cast it as part of casting Contingency, expending the slots for both spells, but the contingent spell does not take effect immediately. It takes effect when a specified trigger occurs. Describe the trigger when you cast the two spells. For example, casting Contingency with Water Breathing can ensure that Water Breathing takes effect when you are submerged in water or a similar liquid.
The contingent spell takes effect immediately the first time the specified circumstance occurs, whether or not you want it to, and Contingency then ends.
The contingent spell affects only you, even if it could normally target others. You can have only one Contingency at a time. If you cast it again, the earlier Contingency on you immediately ends. It also immediately ends if its material component is no longer on your person.
note: M662 Contingency: complete eligibility, both slots, declared trigger/example, involuntary first occurrence, self-only target, one-at-a-time and carried-component ending retained.

source:
你只能在夜晚施展这道法术。选择施法距离内至多三具中型或小型类人生物尸体。每具尸体都会变为一只你控制下的食尸鬼Ghoul（数据见《怪物手册》）。
在每个你的回合用一个附赠动作，你能精神性地命令任何距你120尺内以此法术活化的生物（如果你操纵多个生物，则你的命令可以同时传达给它们中的任意成员，不过只能使用同一种命令）。你决定生物下回合使用何种动作并决定它们移动至何处，抑或你可以下达宽泛的命令，例如守护某个房间或某条走廊。没有接受到你命令的生物则只会采取回避 动作并只会为了避免受伤而移动。一旦被下达命令，该生物会持续执行命令直到任务完成。
你只能操纵生物24小时，在那之后它会拒绝执行你曾下达的任何命令。若你在当前的24小时时间段终止前再次施展此法术，则你对该生物的操纵时间再延长24小时。法术的此种用法只能延长你对至多三个你使用此法术所创造生物的控制时间，不会造出新的生物。
升环施法：使用七环法术位施展该法术时，你可以唤起并维持四只食尸鬼。使用八环法术位施展该法术时，你可以唤起并维持五只食尸鬼，也可以改为唤起并维持两只妖鬼Ghast，或两只尸妖Wight。当你使用九环法术位施展该法术时，你可以唤起并维持六只食尸鬼，也可以改为唤起并维持三只妖鬼，或三只尸妖，或两只木乃伊Mummy。生物的数据均见《怪物手册》。
target:
You can cast this spell only at night. Choose up to three Medium or Small Humanoid corpses within range. Each becomes a Ghoul under your control; use the statistics in the Monster Manual.
As a Bonus Action on each of your turns, you can mentally command a creature you animated with this spell within 120 feet of you. If you control several, you can command any of them at the same time, but must give them the same command. You decide what actions they take and where they move on their next turn, or give a general order, such as guarding a room or corridor. Without a command, a creature only takes the Dodge action and moves to avoid injury. Once commanded, it continues until the task is complete.
You control a creature for only 24 hours, after which it refuses to obey any commands you have given it. Casting this spell again before the current 24-hour period ends extends your control for another 24 hours. Used this way, the spell only extends control over up to three creatures you created with it and creates no new creatures.
Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot: A seventh-level slot lets you raise and maintain four Ghouls. An eighth-level slot lets you raise and maintain five Ghouls, or two Ghasts, or two Wights. A ninth-level slot lets you raise and maintain six Ghouls, or three Ghasts, or three Wights, or two Mummies. Use the creatures' statistics in the Monster Manual.
note: M663 2024 Create Undead: night-only casting, corpse sizes, 120-foot same-command control, default Dodge/avoid injury, all 24-hour refresh limits and complete seventh/eighth/ninth creature alternatives retained.

source:
你向施法距离内一个你能看见的目标射出一道绿色射线。该目标可以是一名生物或一个非魔法物件，或者是魔法力场的造物（例如由力场墙Wall of Force创造的墙壁）。
目标生物必须进行一次敏捷豁免，豁免失败则受10d6+40点力场伤害，若目标生命值因此降至0，则目标连同其穿着和携带的非魔法物品一起化为灰尘。该生物只能通过完全复生术True Resurrection或祈愿术Wish复活。
此法术会直接解离大型或更小的非魔法物件或魔法力场造物。如果目标是巨型或更大的物件或魔法力场造物，则此法术会解离其10尺立方大小的部分。
升环施法效应。使用的法术位每比六环高一环，伤害就提高3d6。
target:
You fire a green ray at a target you can see within range. It can be a creature, a nonmagical object, or a creation of magical force, such as a wall made by Wall of Force.
A creature must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 10d6+40 Force damage on a failure. If this reduces it to 0 Hit Points, it and the nonmagical items it wears and carries turn to dust. The creature can be restored to life only by True Resurrection or Wish.
The spell automatically disintegrates a nonmagical object or creation of magical force that is Large or smaller. If it is Huge or larger, the spell disintegrates a 10-foot cube of it.
Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot: The damage increases by 3d6 for each slot level above sixth.
note: M664 Disintegrate: preserved creature/nonmagical-object/magical-force targets, failure-only damage, dusting at0 with nonmagical items, resurrection exceptions and Large-versus-Huge object handling.

source:
你触摸施展法术时使用的蓝宝石与一件最重不超过10磅，最长不超过6尺的物件。法术在物件上留下一个隐形的标记，也在蓝宝石上留下隐形的物件名称。你每次施展该法术时都必须使用不同的蓝宝石作为其材料成分。
在那之后，你可以用一个魔法动作唤出该物件的名称并粉碎这颗蓝宝石，该物件将无视任何距离和位面的限制立即出现在你的手上，法术随即终止。
如果另一个生物正持握或携带着该物件，则粉碎蓝宝石无法将该物品送过来。不过你会知晓是谁占有了该物品，以及其此刻身处何处。
target:
You touch the sapphire used to cast the spell and an object weighing no more than 10 pounds and measuring no more than 6 feet at its longest dimension. The spell leaves an invisible mark on the object and invisibly inscribes its name on the sapphire. Each casting requires a different sapphire as its material component.
Afterward, you can use a Magic action to speak the object's name and crush the sapphire. The object immediately appears in your hand regardless of distance or plane, and the spell ends.
If another creature is holding or carrying the object, crushing the sapphire does not transport it. Instead, you learn who possesses it and where that creature currently is.
note: M665 Drawmij's Instant Summons: both size/weight limits, invisible marks, distinct sapphire per cast, Magic action/name/crush and possession-failure information retained.

source:
在法术持续时间内，你的眼睛变成漆黑虚空。一名你选择的，距离你60尺内且你可见的生物必须成功于进行一次感知豁免，否则将承受由你选择的下列效应之一直到法术结束。
在法术终止前你的每个回合内，你都可以使用一个魔法动作来指定另一个目标。不过你不能指定那些已经通过本次施展的该法术豁免的生物。
　　• 沉睡Asleep。目标陷入昏迷状态。其在受到任何伤害，或另一个生物使用一个动作摇晃它时，即可再次醒来。
　　• 惊慌Panicked。目标陷入恐慌状态，它必须在其每个自己的回合内执行疾走动作并移动，且以最短、最安全的路径尽可能的逃离你，直至其无路可逃为止。如果目标移至一处距你至少60尺远且看不见你的空间，则此效应终止。
　　• 患病Sickened。目标陷入中毒状态。
target:
For the duration, your eyes become black voids. One creature you choose that you can see within 60 feet must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or suffer one of the following effects of your choice until the spell ends.
On each of your turns before the spell ends, you can use a Magic action to choose another target. You cannot choose a creature that has already succeeded on a save against this casting.
• Asleep. The target has the Unconscious condition. It wakes if it takes any damage or another creature uses an action to shake it.
• Panicked. The target has the Frightened condition. On each of its turns, it must take the Dash action and move as far from you as possible by the shortest, safest route, until it has nowhere left to flee. This effect ends if it moves to a space at least 60 feet from you where it cannot see you.
• Sickened. The target has the Poisoned condition.
note: M666 full rich-text Eyebite source decoded and translated; all three options, successful-save retarget exclusion, Magic action and both Panicked distance/sight conditions retained. Rich-text run application remains pending.

source:
你魔法性地感知到通往你所陈述地点的最直接的物理路径。你必须熟悉你所描述的地点，如果你寻找的目的地在另一存在位面，或者其会不断移动（例如一座移动堡垒），或者描述不够具体（例如“一条绿龙的巢穴”），则该法术失效。
你在法术持续时间内，只要和目的地在同一位面，就能够知晓目的地的远近和所在方向。向目的地移动并遇到岔路时，你会得知哪一条路能够最直接地通往目的地。
target:
You magically sense the most direct physical route to a destination you describe and are familiar with. The spell fails if the destination is on another plane of existence, moves continually, such as a mobile fortress, or is described too vaguely, such as "a green dragon's lair."
For the duration, as long as you are on the same plane as the destination, you know its distance and direction. When traveling toward it and reaching a fork, you know which route leads most directly there.
note: M667 Find the Path: familiarity, all three failure examples/conditions, same-plane ongoing direction and route-choice behavior retained.

source:
你尝试将施法距离内一名你可见的生物变为石头。目标必须进行一次体质豁免。若豁免失败，则目标在法术持续时间内陷入束缚状态。若豁免成功，则目标的速度直至你的下个回合开始前变为0。构装生物进行此豁免时自动成功。
因该法术陷入束缚的生物必须在其每回合结束时再进行一次体质豁免。在累计三次豁免成功后，该法术终止。在累计三次豁免失败后，该生物被转化为石头并在法术持续时间内陷入石化状态。成功或失败的检定不需要连续；只要记录各情况的次数直至其中一方累计三次为止。
如果你为该法术维持的专注持续至法术最大持续时间，则该生物陷入的石化状态将持续至被一道高等复原术Greater Restoration或类似的魔法移除为止。
target:
You try to turn a creature you can see within range to stone. It must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failure, it has the Restrained condition for the duration. On a success, its Speed becomes 0 until the start of your next turn. Constructs automatically succeed on this save.
A creature Restrained by the spell must make another Constitution save at the end of each of its turns. After accumulating three successful saves, the spell ends. After accumulating three failed saves, it turns to stone and has the Petrified condition for the duration. The successes or failures need not be consecutive; keep track of both until either reaches three.
If you maintain Concentration for the spell's maximum duration, the Petrified condition lasts until removed by Greater Restoration or similar magic.
note: M668 2024 Flesh to Stone: retained successful-save Speed0 and Construct automatic success, nonconsecutive three-success/failure tracking and full-Concentration lasting Petrified condition. Did not add a ruling about whether the initial save counts among later accumulated results.

source:
你创造一个对抗魔法旅行的结界，该结界区域至多覆盖40000平方尺地面及其上30尺高的空间。在法术持续时间内，生物无法传送进区域内或使用传送门（如异界之门 gate法术创造的那种）进入其内。该法术使该区域无法进行位面旅行，因此生物无法通过星光位面Astral Plane，以太位面Ethereal Plane，妖精荒野Feywild，堕影冥界Shadowfell，或是通过位面转移plane shift 法术进入该区域。
此外，该法术可以对你在施法时所选定类别的生物造成伤害。从下列选项中选择一项或多项：异怪、天族、元素、妖精、邪魔、亡灵。所选定生物在一个回合内首次进入法术区域或者在其内结束回合时，将受到5d10点光耀伤害或黯蚀伤害（由你在施法时选择其一）。
施展该法术时，你可以设定一段密语。说出密语的生物即使进入区域也不会受到该法术的伤害。
该法术的效应区域不能与另一道禁制术的区域相重叠。如果你对同一区域连续30日每日施展禁制术，则其效应会持续至被解除，并在最后一次施法时将该法术的材料成分消耗殆尽。
target:
You create a ward against magical travel, covering up to 40000 square feet of ground and the space 30 feet above it. For the duration, creatures cannot teleport into the area or enter through portals, such as those created by Gate. The spell seals the area against planar travel, so creatures cannot enter through the Astral Plane, Ethereal Plane, Feywild, Shadowfell, or Plane Shift.
The spell can also damage creature types you choose when casting it. Choose one or more: Aberrations, Celestials, Elementals, Fey, Fiends, or Undead. When a chosen creature enters the area for the first time on a turn or ends its turn there, it takes 5d10 Radiant or Necrotic damage, which you choose when casting.
You can set a password when you cast the spell. A creature that speaks it takes no damage from the spell even when entering the area.
The area cannot overlap another Forbiddance. If you cast the spell on the same area each day for 30 consecutive days, it lasts until dispelled, and its material components are consumed on the final casting.
note: M669 Forbiddance: area/height, all planar examples, six creature types and Radiant-or-Necrotic choice retained. 2024 source end-turn damage is not changed to start-turn; password prevents damage, not an invented bypass of travel restrictions.

source:
一个固定的微光屏障在你周围10尺光环范围内出现并在法术持续时间内维持存在。
任何在屏障外施放的五环或更低环阶的法术无法影响其内的任何东西。此类法术能够以屏障内的生物或物件为目标，但无法对其生效。同样的，屏障内区域也将被排除在此类法术所创造的效应区域之外。
升环施法：使用的法术位每比六环高一环，屏障能阻挡的法术就高一环。
target:
A stationary, shimmering barrier appears in a 10-foot Emanation around you and remains for the duration.
A spell of fifth level or lower cast from outside the barrier cannot affect anything inside it. Such spells can target creatures or objects within, but have no effect on them. The barrier's interior is also excluded from the areas of effect they create.
Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot: For each slot level above sixth, the barrier blocks spells of one level higher.
note: M670 2024 Globe of Invulnerability: stationary barrier, outside-origin restriction, target/area exclusions and scaling preserved. No old-edition clause about original level regardless of casting slot is inserted.

source:
你制造一个覆盖至多2500平方尺地面面积的受保护区域。保护区域至高可达20尺，并随你的意愿塑形为一个50尺的方形区域，或一百个相接的5尺方形区域，或二十五个相接的10尺方形区域。
施展该法术时，你可以指明特定个体以让其不受法术效应的影响。你还可以指明一句口令，当在保护区域5尺内并大声说出口令时，即可让说出口令的人对这些效应免疫。
法术在受保护区域内创造出下述效应。解除魔法Dispel Magic对铜墙铁壁本身没有效果，但下述每个效应都能被分别解除。如果所有四个效应均被解除，则本法术结束。如果你365日中每日均对同一区域施展该法术，此法术便会持续至其所有效应均被解除为止。
　　• 过道Corridors。浓雾充斥受保护的过道使其处于重度遮蔽。此外，除你以外的生物在过道上遇到需要选择方向的岔路或交叉路口时，有50%概率误认错的方向为正确的前进方向。
　　• 门Door。所有受保护区域内的门都被魔法性地锁住，如同被秘法锁Arcane Lock封上一般。此外，你还可以用一道幻象掩盖至多十扇门使其看起来有如普通墙面的一部分。
　　• 楼梯Stairs。受保护区域内的楼梯从上到下布满了蛛网，如同受到蛛网术Web的效应一般。铜墙铁壁法术持续期间，这些蛛网即使被摧毁也可以在10分钟后再次生成。

其他法术效应Other Spell Effect。你可以在要塞的保护区域内布置你指定的下列魔法效应之一：
　　• 在四条过道中布置舞光术Dancing Lights。你可以为光点其指定一个简单的程序，使其在铜墙铁壁持续期间重复此程序。
　　• 在两个地点布置魔嘴术Magic Mouth。
　　• 在两个地点布置臭云术Stinking Cloud（在铜墙铁壁法术持续期间，臭气即使被驱散也会在10分钟后重新聚集）
　　• 在一条过道或一个房间中布置一道造风术Gust of Wind（法术持续期间，风会一直吹）
　　• 在一个至多5尺的方形区域布置一道暗示术Suggestion。任何进入该区域的生物将通过精神受到法术的暗示。
target:
You create a warded area covering up to 2500 square feet of floor space. It can be up to 20 feet high and shaped as you wish into a 50-foot square, one hundred contiguous 5-foot squares, or twenty-five contiguous 10-foot squares.
When you cast the spell, you can designate individuals who are unaffected. You can also specify a password; speaking it aloud within 5 feet of the warded area makes the speaker immune to these effects.
The spell creates the following effects in the warded area. Dispel Magic has no effect on Guards and Wards itself, but each effect below can be dispelled separately. The spell ends if all four effects are dispelled. If you cast it on the same area every day for 365 days, it lasts until all its effects are dispelled.
• Corridors. Thick fog fills the warded corridors, making them Heavily Obscured. In addition, when a creature other than you reaches a junction or intersection requiring a choice of direction, it has a 50% chance to mistake the wrong way for the correct one.
• Door. All doors in the warded area are magically locked as if by Arcane Lock. You can also conceal up to ten doors with an illusion that makes them look like part of an ordinary wall.
• Stairs. Stairs in the area are filled with webs from top to bottom as if affected by Web. While Guards and Wards lasts, destroyed webs regrow after 10 minutes.

Other Spell Effect. You can place one of the following magical effects in the fortress's warded area:
• Dancing Lights in four corridors. You can give the lights a simple program to repeat throughout Guards and Wards.
• Magic Mouth in two locations.
• Stinking Cloud in two locations; while Guards and Wards lasts, dispersed fumes return after 10 minutes.
• Gust of Wind in one corridor or room; the wind blows for the duration.
• Suggestion in a square up to 5 feet on a side. Any creature entering it receives the spell's suggestion mentally.
note: M671 complete rich-text Guards and Wards retained: all floor shapes, exclusions/password, four effect groups, all five extra-effect choices, regeneration timings and 365-day permanence. Dispel Magic handling remains the 2024 source. Rich-text formatting application pending.

source: 你对施法距离内一个你可见的生物降下恶毒致命的魔法。目标必须通过一次体质豁免，豁免失败将受到14d6点暗蚀伤害，并且它的生命值上限会降低等同它所受暗蚀伤害数值点。豁免成功则仅受到一半伤害。此法术不能将目标的生命值上限降至1以下。
target: You unleash virulent, deadly magic on a creature you can see within range. The target must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failure, it takes 14d6 Necrotic damage and its Hit Point maximum is reduced by the Necrotic damage it takes. On a success, it takes only half damage. This spell cannot reduce the target's Hit Point maximum below 1.
note: M672 2024 Harm: failure-only maximum-HP reduction and maximum floor1 preserved. The source does not supply a recovery duration or a floor on current Hit Points; neither added.

source:
指定施法距离内一个你能看见的生物。汹涌澎湃的正能量将充盈该生物，使其恢复 70 点生命值。该法术也会终止正在影响目标的目盲、耳聋以及中毒状态。
升环施法： 使用的法术位每比六环高一环，此法术的治疗量就增加10点。
target:
Choose a creature you can see within range. A surge of positive energy fills it, restoring 70 Hit Points. The spell also ends the Blinded, Deafened, and Poisoned conditions affecting it.
Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot: Healing increases by 10 for each slot level above sixth.
note: M673 2024 Heal: 70 healing, all three listed conditions and 10-point scaling retained; no disease or creature-type exclusions imported.

source:
你咒唤一场盛宴出现在你周围地面上未被占据的10尺立方空间。盛宴需要1小时来享用，并会在这段时间结束后消失不见，而且下述增益效应在这1小时结束前不会生效。你可以让至多十二个生物一同分享盛宴。
所有享用了大餐的生物都会获得几种增益。这些生物获得毒素伤害的抗性、中毒状态免疫与恐慌状态免疫，他们的生命值上限也将提高2d10点（并获得等量的生命值）。这些增益将持续 24 小时。
target:
You conjure a feast in an unoccupied 10-foot cube on the ground around you. It takes 1 hour to consume and disappears at the end of that time. The benefits below do not take effect until that 1 hour is over. You can have up to twelve creatures share it.
Each creature that partakes gains several benefits: resistance to Poison damage, immunity to the Poisoned and Frightened conditions, and an increase of 2d10 to its Hit Point maximum, gaining the same number of Hit Points. These benefits last 24 hours.
note: M674 2024 Heroes' Feast: placement, one-hour completion/disappearance, twelve participants and exact benefit set retained. Poison damage resistance remains resistance, not immunity; no Wisdom-save or disease benefit from another edition added.

source:
你的灵魂离开身体进入作为法术材料成分的容器中，而你的身体则陷入失神的状况。灵魂处于容器中时，你可以如同身处容器所在位置一样察觉周边。你不能移动，也不能使用反应，而此时你唯一能做的动作就是将你的灵魂投射出容器至多100 尺的距离，回到你仍活着的身体中去（并终止该法术），或者尝试占据另一个类人生物的身体。
你可以尝试附身于任何距你100尺内你能看见的类人生物（受法术防护善恶Protection from Evil或防护法阵Magic Cricle所保护的生物无法被附身）。该目标必须进行一次魅力豁免。豁免失败，则你的灵魂进入目标的身体，而目标的灵魂被困在容器中；豁免成功，则目标抵抗了你的附身，而随后的 24 小时内你将无法再次尝试附身该生物。
附身成功后，目标生物的身体将由你控制。你的生命值、生命骰、力量、敏捷、体质、速度和感官替换为目标生物的数据，此外将保留你的游戏数据。
附身期间，被附身生物的灵魂可以用它自己的感官从容器内部观察外部，但它不能移动且陷入失能状态。
附身于一具躯体时，如果容器处在你身边 100 尺内，则你可以用一个魔法动作从宿主的身体回到容器中，并让宿主的灵魂回到它自己的身体里。在你处于宿主的身体中时，如果宿主的身体死亡，则宿主生物死亡，且你必须进行一次对抗该法术豁免 DC 的魅力豁免。豁免成功且容器距你不超过 100 尺时，你回归容器内。否则你也随之死亡。
如果容器被毁或者法术终止，则你的灵魂会立即回到你自己身体里。如果你在尝试回到自己身体时，身体距你超过 100 尺或者你的身体已死，则你也随之死亡。如果容器被毁时另一生物的灵魂在容器内，且该生物的身体仍然活着并距它不超过 100 尺，则其灵魂会回到身体里。否则该生物死亡。
该法术终止时，其容器将随之被摧毁。
target:
Your soul leaves your body and enters the container used as the spell's material component, leaving your body in a catatonic state. While in the container, you perceive your surroundings as if you were there. You cannot move or take Reactions. The only action you can take is to project your soul up to 100 feet out of the container, returning to your still-living body and ending the spell, or attempting to possess another Humanoid's body.
You can try to possess a Humanoid you can see within 100 feet. A creature protected by Protection from Evil or Magic Circle cannot be possessed. The target must make a Charisma saving throw. On a failure, your soul enters its body and its soul is trapped in the container. On a success, it resists your possession, and you cannot try to possess it again for 24 hours.
After possession succeeds, you control the target's body. Your Hit Points, Hit Dice, Strength, Dexterity, Constitution, Speed, and Senses are replaced by its statistics; you retain your other game statistics.
While possessed, the creature's soul can observe outside the container using its own senses, but it cannot move and has the Incapacitated condition.
While possessing a body, if the container is within 100 feet, you can use a Magic action to return from the host's body to the container, returning the host's soul to its own body. If the host's body dies while you are in it, the host dies and you must make a Charisma saving throw against this spell's save DC. If you succeed and the container is within 100 feet, you return to it. Otherwise, you also die.
If the container is destroyed or the spell ends, your soul immediately returns to your own body. If that body is more than 100 feet away or is dead when you try to return, you also die. If another creature's soul is in the container when it is destroyed, that soul returns to its body if the body is still alive and within 100 feet. Otherwise, that creature dies.
The container is destroyed when the spell ends.
note: M675 full 2024 Magic Jar retained: exact seven replaced-stat categories, all soul/host/container branches, 100-foot and 24-hour gates, Magic action and deaths. Protection from Evil remains as supplied. The source typo Magic Cricle is corrected to Magic Circle in the translated display text, supported by this workbook A377/N377; original source fields remain unchanged. No extra class-feature rule is added.

source:
你以魔法影响施法距离内至多十二个你能看见的生物，并对其施以某种行动暗示（至多以25个字的形式）。你指定的受术目标必须能听到并理解你的话语。你的暗示言辞必须是听起来可实现的，且不涉及任何伤害目标或其盟友的内容。例如，你可以说”沿那条路走到村子，并帮那儿的村民收庄稼直到日落。”或者你可以说“现在不是打架的时候。放下你们的武器，跳舞吧！跳上一个小时。”
每个目标必须进行一次感知豁免，豁免失败者将陷入魅惑状态，直到法术持续时间结束为止，如果你或你的盟友对其造成伤害时此状态将提前结束。每个受魅惑的目标将尽其所能地从事你所暗示的行为。暗示的行为可能会在整个法术持续时间内持续进行；而如果你所暗示的活动可以用更短的时间完成，则在完成了活动的目标身上该法术提前终止。
你也可以描述一种在持续时间内发生的特定状况，作为触发特殊行为的条件。例如，你可以暗示一队士兵将所有的钱交给他们遇到的第一个乞丐。如果在法术终止前条件始终没有满足，则指定的行为不会被执行。
如果你或你同伴中的任何人伤害了一个被该法术影响的生物，则该法术对该生物产生的效应随之终止。
升环施法：使用的法术位高于六环时，法术的持续时间增加，七环为10日，八环为30日，九环为366日。
target:
You magically influence up to twelve creatures you can see within range, suggesting a course of action in no more than 25 characters. The targets must be able to hear and understand you. Your suggestion must sound achievable and involve no harm to the targets or their allies. For example: "Follow that road to the village and help the villagers harvest their crops until sunset." Or: "Now is no time to fight. Put down your weapons and dance for an hour!"
Each target must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, it has the Charmed condition for the duration, ending early if you or your allies damage it. Each Charmed target carries out the suggested activity to the best of its ability. It might continue for the entire duration; if the activity can be completed sooner, the spell ends on a target when it finishes.
You can also specify a circumstance during the duration that triggers a particular action. For example, you could suggest that a group of soldiers give all their money to the first beggar they meet. If the circumstance never occurs before the spell ends, they do not perform that action.
If you or any of your companions harm a creature affected by this spell, its effect on that creature ends.
Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot: A slot above sixth level increases the duration: seventh level gives 10 days, eighth level gives 30 days, and ninth level gives 366 days.
note: M676 full 2024 Mass Suggestion: source says 25 characters; not changed to remembered words, and translated examples remain complete. Both harm-ending statements, achievable/non-harmful wording, per-target completion, contingent instruction example and 10/30/366-day scaling retained.

source:
指定施法距离内一处在任何方向上都不超过40 尺的地形区域，在法术持续时间内，你可以随意重塑区域内的泥土，沙土或黏土。你可以升高或降低区域内的地面高度，制造或填平一道沟渠，竖起或夷平一道屏障，或是形成一根立柱。上述任何改造的地形范围不得超过整个区域最大边长的一半。例如，如果你影响了 40 尺立方区域，则你可以创造一根至多20尺高的立柱，将地面升高或降低至多 20 尺，挖一条至多 20 尺深的壕沟，等等。这些改变一共需要花10分钟的时间来完成。由于地形的变化发生得很缓慢，区域内的生物通常不会被地面的移动困住或者受伤。
每为法术维持10分钟专注，你都可以选择一片新的地形区域再施以影响。
该法术无法改变天然的岩石或石制建筑。但石头和建筑仍会因适应地形的变化而被改变。如果你改变地形的方式会使得建筑不稳定，则它有可能倒塌。
类似地，该法术也无法直接影响植物生长。而被移走的泥土会带走任何生长在其上的植物。
target:
Choose an area of terrain within range that measures no more than 40 feet in any direction. For the duration, you can reshape its dirt, sand, or clay as you wish. You can raise or lower the ground, create or fill a ditch, build or flatten a barrier, or form a pillar. No alteration can exceed half the area's longest dimension. For example, in a 40-foot cube, you could make a pillar up to 20 feet high, raise or lower the ground by up to 20 feet, or dig a trench up to 20 feet deep. These changes take 10 minutes to complete. Because the terrain changes slowly, creatures in the area are usually not trapped or injured by its movement.
For every 10 minutes you maintain Concentration, you can choose a new area of terrain to affect.
The spell cannot change natural rock or stone structures directly, but rocks and structures are still affected as they adjust to the terrain's changes. A structure might collapse if your alteration makes it unstable.
Likewise, the spell does not directly affect plant growth, but moved earth carries any plants growing on it.
note: M677 Move Earth: all terrain operations, half-largest-dimension limit/examples,10-minute change/new-area timing, slow-change safety and indirect structure/plant effects retained.

source:
一颗冰球从你的指尖射向施法距离内你指定的一点，并在该处迸裂为一个半径60尺的球状区域。区域内的每个生物必须进行一次体质豁免。豁免失败者受到10d6点寒冷伤害，豁免成功则只受一半伤害。
如果冰球击中某处水体，水面将在边长30尺的方形区域内凝结出6寸厚的坚冰。任何在其表面上游泳的生物将被冰面所困，陷入束缚状态。受困的生物可以用一个动作进行一次对抗你的法术豁免DC的力量（运动）检定以破冰挣脱。
你可以在施法完毕后不发射冰球。此时你手上将出现一枚投石索子弹大小的触感冰冷的小冰球。你可以选择将冰球交给任意一名生物。持有冰球的生物可以将冰球投出去（射程至多为40尺）或者用投石索将其弹射出去（射程至多为投石索的常规射程）。冰球将在撞击时破碎，产生与正常施法时相同的效应。你还可以将冰球放下而不直接打破它。冰球若在1分钟后仍未被打破，它将自动爆炸。
升环施法：使用的法术位每比六环高一环，其伤害就增加1d6。
target:
A ball of ice flies from your fingertips to a point you choose within range, bursting into a Sphere with a radius of 60 feet. Each creature in the area must make a Constitution saving throw, taking 10d6 Cold damage on a failure or half as much on a success.
If the ball strikes a body of water, the surface freezes into a square 30 feet on a side and 6 cun thick. Creatures swimming on that surface are trapped in the ice and have the Restrained condition. A trapped creature can use an action to make a Strength (Athletics) check against your spell save DC to break free.
You can choose not to launch the ball when you finish casting. Instead, a small, cold ball of ice the size of a sling bullet appears in your hand. You can give it to any creature. Its holder can throw it up to 40 feet or launch it with a sling up to the sling's normal range. It shatters on impact with the same effect as a normal casting. You can also set it down without breaking it. If it has not broken after 1 minute, it explodes automatically.
Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot: The damage increases by 1d6 for each slot level above sixth.
note: M678 Otiluke's Freezing Sphere: full immediate/held-ball modes, water freezing, restraint escape check, throw/sling ranges and automatic explosion retained. Bare6cun remains unconverted; source has no ice-expiry duration or action cost for throwing, so neither added.

source:
一名施法距离内你可见的生物必须进行一次感知豁免，豁免成功则目标直到其下个回合结束为止会跳起滑稽的舞蹈，在此期间其必须消耗所有的移动力在原地跳舞。
若豁免失败，目标将在法术持续时间内陷入魅惑状态。处于魅惑状态期间，目标会跳起滑稽的舞蹈，必须使用所有的移动力在原地跳舞，并且进行的敏捷豁免与攻击检定具有劣势，且其他生物以该生物为目标发动的攻击检定具有优势。在目标的每个自己的回合，它可以用一个动作尝试使自己镇定下来并重复豁免，豁免成功则其身上的法术终止。
target:
A creature you can see within range must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a success, it performs a comical dance until the end of its next turn, spending all its movement to dance in place.
On a failure, the target has the Charmed condition for the duration. While Charmed, it dances comically and must spend all its movement to dance in place. It has disadvantage on Dexterity saving throws and attack rolls, and other creatures have advantage on attack rolls against it. On each of its turns, it can use an action to try to compose itself and repeat the save, ending the spell on itself on a success.
note: M679 2024 Otto's Irresistible Dance: initial successful-save short dance and failed-save Charmed/full penalties are separate; next-turn END timing and action-to-repeat-save retained.

source:
你祈求一名异界实体的援助。你必须对该存在有所了解，它可以是一位神祇，一名恶魔主君，或是其他拥有宇宙级伟力的存在。该实体将派遣一名效忠它的天族生物，元素生物或邪魔生物来援助你，并使该生物显现在施法距离内一处未占空间。如果你知道某个特定生物的名字，则你可以在施展法术时说出其名字来请求指派该生物来援，但是你仍然有可能得到一名不同的生物（由DM选择）。
该生物出现时，它并未被强迫做任何事。你可以用报酬为交换，请求其提供服务，但它并没有为你实现请求的义务。请求的任务可以简单（帮我们飞越峡谷，或协助我们进行一场战斗），也可以复杂（暗中监视我们的敌人，或在我们扫荡地城时保护我们）。你必须能与该生物交流从而为其服务讨价还价。
报酬的形式各式各样。一名天族可能会要求为一座同盟的神殿捐献一份相当可观的金币或魔法物品，而一只邪魔可能会索要一次活祭或一份财宝作为礼物。一些生物可能会要求你进行一个任务来换取它们的服务。
一个可以按分钟计算的任务需要每分钟100GP的报酬。一个可以按小时计算的任务需要每小时1000GP的报酬。一个可以按日计算的任务（至多10日）需要每日10000GP 的报酬。DM可以按你施展该法术时的具体情况调整报酬。如果任务与生物的行为准则一致，则其可能只会索取一半报酬甚至不收取报酬。没有风险的任务一般只需要建议报酬的一半，而特别危险的任务可能会需要更大的赠礼。生物极少接受看上去像自杀的任务。
生物完成任务后，或当提前商定的服务时间结束后，生物会在情况允许时回来向你报告，然后再返回自己的家乡位面。如果你不能就生物的服务价格与之达成共识，该生物将立即返回其家乡位面。
target:
You ask an otherworldly entity for aid. You must be familiar with it; it might be a deity, a demon lord, or another being of cosmic power. It sends a Celestial, Elemental, or Fiend that serves it to help you, appearing in an unoccupied space within range. If you know a particular creature's name, you can speak it while casting to request that creature, but a different one might still arrive, as the DM chooses.
The creature is not compelled to do anything when it appears. You can offer payment for its service, but it has no obligation to fulfill your request. A task might be simple, such as flying you across a chasm or helping in a battle, or complex, such as spying on enemies or protecting you as you clear a dungeon. You must be able to communicate with it to negotiate.
Payment can take many forms. A Celestial might ask for a substantial donation of gold or magic items to an allied temple; a Fiend might demand a living sacrifice or a gift of treasure. Some creatures might ask you to complete a quest in exchange for their service.
A task measured in minutes costs 100 GP per minute. One measured in hours costs 1000 GP per hour. One measured in days, up to 10 days, costs 10000 GP per day. The DM can adjust payment to the circumstances of the casting. A task consistent with the creature's principles might cost half as much or nothing. A risk-free task usually costs half the suggested payment, while an especially dangerous one might require a greater gift. Creatures rarely accept apparently suicidal tasks.
After completing the task or reaching the agreed end of service, the creature returns to report if circumstances allow, then returns to its home plane. If you cannot agree on payment, it returns to its home plane immediately.
note: M680 2024 Planar Ally: all requested/random servant, voluntary negotiation, task/payment examples and return clauses retained. Actual source prices100/1000/10000GP and maximum10days are deliberately preserved, not replaced with another edition's lower figures.
